pre_result_data_quality_amendment: After both venue files were downloaded but before any signal or PnL was computed, the Binance February 2023 H1 mark archives were found to omit 48 hours for both symbols. Exact timestamps are attempted first from checksum-verified public Binance 1m mark archives. Those archives omit the same outage, so the remaining marks use only the real same-hour Binance perpetual OHLC as a disclosed MTM/basis proxy; it can never fill an order. No interpolation, trading rule or risk parameter changed. An hour without native mark, exact 1m mark and same-hour perpetual rejects the replay.
hypothesis: A persistent same-asset funding-rate difference plus a non-negative cross-venue basis can produce market-neutral net PnL after conservative execution costs.

capital.margin_mode: isolated and separately accounted; no cross-venue collateral netting

signal.decision_time: Immediately after a funding timestamp shared by both venues, using only settlements at or before that timestamp
signal.funding_normalization: Each realized funding rate divided by its actual elapsed hours since the preceding settlement on that venue; only paired timestamps are compared
signal.estimate: EWMA of the latest 9 paired hourly-normalized funding differences with half-life 3 observations
signal.persistence: The selected orientation must have the same non-zero sign in at least 5 of the latest 6 paired observations
signal.basis: On the latest fully completed H1 mark bar, ln(mark_short_venue / mark_long_venue) must be between 0 and +100 bps
signal.selection: When flat, choose the qualifying symbol with the highest projected 7d funding spread; deterministic ETH then SOL tie-break
signal.execution_delay: Decision at settlement t; atomic two-leg market fill at the first common real traded H1 open at or after t+1h; no synthetic fill
signal.quantity: Identical base-asset quantity on both venues, set so neither entry leg exceeds $60 notional

normal_exit: after minimum hold, projected 7d spread <=10 bps at two consecutive paired settlement updates
after minimum hold, original funding orientation reverses at two consecutive paired settlement updates
risk_exit_immediate_next_real_h1_open: cross-venue basis moves adversely by 150 bps from entry
either venue effective mark leverage exceeds 0.80x
position_management.cooldown: Two subsequent paired settlement observations after exit
position_management.funding: Booked on each venue only for settlements strictly after fill and at or before exit, using that venue's mark price and the actual position side

data.source: Anonymous public Binance Data Vision archives and Bybit V5 public market endpoints; no account, private application or API key
data.streams: H1 traded perpetual OHLC, H1 mark OHLC and realized funding history for both venues
data.missing_policy: Missing or duplicate execution/funding data is never forward-filled into a signal or fill. A missing Binance H1 mark uses the exact same timestamp from its checksum-verified public 1m mark archive, then only the real same-hour Binance perpetual price as a disclosed MTM/basis proxy. Proxy marks can never fill an order. A setup waits for a common real H1 open; every unresolved valuation gap rejects the affected replay.

windows.genuine_oos: data after 2026-09-01 under the unchanged protocol

historical_gate: stress total net PnL >0 in development, validation and retrospective evaluation
funding PnL minus all fees and slippage >0 in every window so basis timing cannot rescue the mechanism
zero venue collateral exhaustion, minimum venue equity >=$75 and maximum venue mark leverage <=0.80x
at least 30 independent episodes total and at least 8 in validation and 8 in retrospective evaluation
no symbol contributes more than 70% of positive net PnL
paper_gate: Even a historical pass permits only frozen paper-forward. Live requires at least 6 prospective months, 20 closed episodes, positive stress-adjusted PnL, hedge success above 99%, and measured one-leg exposure below two seconds at the 99th percentile.
anti_overfit: One central configuration only. EWMA 6/12, threshold 50/70 bps and minimum hold 48/96h may be reported later only as a non-selective neighborhood; they cannot replace a failing center configuration.
limitations: Historical H1 data cannot model order-book queue, partial fills, API outage, ADL or withdrawal suspension.
Venue default, USDT depeg and transfer latency remain unhedged operational risks.
A positive historical result is not a promise of $25/day; target capital must be computed from prospective lower-bound yield, not leverage.
